audit_scope: All token-level and activation-level evidence must be mapped through every projection in Pi.

primary_conclusion_rule.projection_dependent: If ranking or effect direction changes across projections, label the conclusion projection-dependent.
primary_conclusion_rule.selected_projection_claims: Forbidden: treating two selected projections as a robustness audit.
primary_conclusion_rule.sign_invariance: Primary conclusions require invariant effect direction across pi_1, pi_2, pi_3, and pi_4.

projection_family.definition: For each trace step, sum evidence over tokens or units assigned to that step and divide by total absolute evidence mass in the trace.
projection_family.formula: score_j = sum_{a in step_j} e_a / sum_a abs(e_a)
projection_family.name: sum_normalized_pooling

projection_family.definition: For each trace step, average token-level or activation-level evidence assigned to that step.
projection_family.name: mean_pooling

projection_family.definition: For each trace step, compute the L2 norm of token-level or activation-level evidence assigned to that step.
projection_family.name: l2_norm_pooling

projection_family.definition: For each trace step, sum absolute evidence mass and divide by the number of tokens or units assigned to that step.
projection_family.formula: score_j = sum_{a in step_j} abs(e_a) / max(1, length(step_j))
projection_family.name: length_normalized_attribution_mass
